title: I'm building an AI tool that turns your text story into a playable RPG
author: PodrickPayn3

comments.author: PodrickPayn3
comments.body:
I'm building a way to make your own role-playing video game, just by writing a story. The app uses that story to then generate character images, immersive scenes, with turn-based combat and branching dialogue, and everything that makes a role-playing game great.

The roadmap woule be:

   
\- Level-based RPG (current version, iOS only) 

\- 2D Adventure RPG

\- Dating Simulation 

\- 3D RPG

\- VR experience  


All generated by simply typing in your story.   


I'm currently solo developing on it. If this sounds like something you are interested in, check out more here: [https://linktr.ee/\_pexel](https://linktr.ee/_pexel)
